question: Does provenance disambiguate what geometry cannot?
prediction_made_before_measuring: Provenance alone will not disambiguate R1; exclusion by surviving references will.
prediction_outcome: Confirmed, and exceeded: provenance as a hard filter is not merely unhelpful, it is harmful.

strategies.G+E: geometry, minus candidates already claimed by a reference that still resolves
strategies.G+P: geometry, filtered to candidates whose originating tag equals the stored one

scenarios.name: lone reference, same change as R1
negative control, ground truth deliberately wrong

findings.exclusion_strictly_better: G+E matched or beat G on every break and was never worse. 4 of 7 correct against 3 of 7.
findings.provenance_harmful_as_filter: G+P lost both R4 cases that geometry alone got right, because the replaced tool's tag no longer exists and the filter rejects every candidate.
findings.why_provenance_fails: Provenance is not independent information about the broken case. When the originating tag survives, the reference itself usually survives too, so provenance adds nothing; when the reference breaks because the generator changed, the tag has broken with it. G+P's single success was R3, the one case where the tag survived - and there geometry already worked.
findings.exclusion_depends_on_document_richness: R5 is R1 with a single reference instead of four. G+E degrades exactly to G and abstains. Exclusion's power comes entirely from the document holding other references that still resolve.
findings.abstention_is_the_common_outcome: 3 of 7 breaks end in abstention even with the best strategy. Safe, but not a fix.

caveats: Provenance was tested as a HARD FILTER. As a score bonus it would be inert on these scenarios: in every broken case no candidate carries the stored tag, so the bonus is zero for all candidates and the ranking is identical to G. Never harmful, never helpful here - but untested where a tag survives alongside genuine geometric ambiguity.
Seven breaks across five scenarios, box-and-cylinder geometry, faces only.
The abstention thresholds (score 0.50, margin 0.05) are still unprincipled, carried over from round 003.
